audit.whatIsWrong: Disdain (E) was described only as 'his E flip' with a generic filler description, and Purge's don't-entry named no numbers. Fear Beyond Death's 2500 range was never stated.
audit.why: Riot kit: Disdain 16/15.5/15/14.5/14s cooldown, 475 range, shields him — it is his only gap-closer AND his only shield, so dodging it removes both for the full cooldown. Purge is 490 range and drops to 0 cooldown / 0 cost at rank 5. Fear Beyond Death has 2500 range, so disengaging out of melee does not put you outside it.
audit.corrected: Rewrote dosFull[0].d, dosFull[1].d, dontsFull[0].d, dontsFull[1].d and spikes[1].text with the real ranges and cooldowns.

audit.whatIsWrong: Text asserts Undying Rage 'shrugs off'/is beaten 'through the tail of' Fear Beyond Death's execute.
audit.why: Whether the execute can fire while Undying Rage is active is not in Riot's ability text and is not in the kit file; needsResearch is empty, which means unknown, not confirmed.
audit.corrected: Rephrased around the verifiable half: after the 5 seconds end you are critically low and still inside a 2500-range execute.

edits.before: Urgot's Fear Beyond Death (R) is a hard problem — if he drops you below the execute threshold his ult snaps you in and shrugs off Undying Rage timing, so respect the R line and don't fight at low HP even during your immortality window.
